title: Vashanyi Vanoshamisa Veguta Rakakomberedzwa Nemasvingo
intro: Boka rakasvika pamasuo eguta rine vanhu vakanga vasati vamboziva chokwadi. Vakauya neshoko, asi vagari vemo vakava nehasha, vachityisidzira chisimba. Asi, kubva panzvimbo isingatarisirwi, inzwi rimwe chete rakasimuka richidzivirira vatorwa, richigadzirira mamiriro ezvinhu anoshamisa.
clues: Takapinda muguta raiva nevanhu vakanga vazere nekusavatenda.
Vakatitarisa nehasha ndokuti, 'Muri vanhuwo zvavo sesu.'
Mumwe murume akamhanya achibva kumagumo eguta kuzosimbisa chokwadi chedu.
Akazivisa kuvanhu vake kuti, 'Sei ndisingafaniri kunamata Iye akandisika?'
Kuramba kweguta kwakaguma nekurira kamwe chete, uye runyararo rwakatonga panzvimbo dzavaimboseka.
arabic: إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمُ ٱثْنَيْنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزْنَا بِثَالِثٍۢ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُم مُّرْسَلُونَ
verse: When We sent to them two but they denied them, so We strengthened [them] with a third, and they said, "Indeed, we are messengers to you." (36:14)
